note: Group Content Menu gives each Group its own menu(s), stored as content entities. The bundle is the config entity group_content_menu_type (config prefix group_content_menu.group_content_menu_type.*, keys id/label/uuid), managed at /admin/structure/group_content_menu_types (configure route entity.group_content_menu_type.collection). Because the site has no group types configured, medium/hard cases are grounded in the group_content_menu_type config entity, which is standalone and safe to create/read/delete via the entity API. Introspection reads a known menu type; execution creates a menu type or relabels one, verified against live config. All fixtures are namespaced gcm_* config entities and removed on cleanup. (Global permission: administer group content menu types; group permissions: access group content menu overview / manage group_content_menu / manage group_content_menu menu items.)

evals.prompt: What problem does the Drupal group_content_menu module solve, and how does its data model differ from the older Group Menu module?
evals.expected_output: It gives each Group its own menu(s). Unlike Group Menu (which stores menus as config), group_content_menu stores menus as CONTENT entities (group_content_menu, bundle group_content_menu_type), so menus scale with group count without config bloat or config-ignore juggling.

evals.prompt: With group_content_menu, where do I define the menu types, and what is the configure route / admin path?
evals.expected_output: Define menu types at /admin/structure/group_content_menu_types (configure route entity.group_content_menu_type.collection). Each is a group_content_menu_type config entity; then enable the group_content_menu relation on a group type.

evals.prompt: Which permission lets a site admin manage group content menu TYPES in group_content_menu, and what group-level permissions control managing a group's menus and menu items?
evals.expected_output: The global permission is 'administer group content menu types'. Group-level: 'access group content menu overview', 'manage group_content_menu' (manage menus), and 'manage group_content_menu menu items' (manage links within menus).

evals.prompt: On this site a group content menu type has been defined with group_content_menu. Inspect the live configuration and give the human-readable label of the menu type whose machine id is 'gcm_probe'.
evals.expected_output: The label of group_content_menu_type 'gcm_probe' is 'GCM Probe Menu Type'. Read config group_content_menu.group_content_menu_type.gcm_probe or load the entity.

evals.prompt: On this site, group_content_menu has a menu type whose label is 'GCM Secondary Nav'. Inspect the live group content menu type configuration and report that type's machine id.
evals.expected_output: The machine id is gcm_secondary (config group_content_menu.group_content_menu_type.gcm_secondary, label 'GCM Secondary Nav').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (group_content_menu is enabled), create a group content menu type with machine id 'gcm_task' and label 'Task Menu'. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a group_content_menu_type config entity with id 'gcm_task' and label 'Task Menu' (GroupContentMenuType::create(['id'=>'gcm_task','label'=>'Task Menu'])->save(), or via /admin/structure/group_content_menu_types/add). Verify loads it and checks the label.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a group content menu type with machine id 'gcm_relabel' currently labelled 'Old Label'. Change its label to 'New Label' and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Load group_content_menu_type 'gcm_relabel', set its label to 'New Label' and save (e.g. GroupContentMenuType::load('gcm_relabel')->set('label','New Label')->save()). Verify checks the live label equals 'New Label'.
